description: The file defines utility functions for size calculations such as min, max, division with rounding, and rounding up, intended for internal use within QNNPACK components.

methods.name: size_t min(size_t a,size_t b)
methods.description: Returns the smaller of two size_t values.

methods.name: size_t max(size_t a,size_t b)
methods.description: Returns the larger of two size_t values.

methods.name: size_t doz(size_t a,size_t b)
methods.description: Returns zero if a is less than b; otherwise returns the difference a - b.

methods.name: size_t divide_round_up(size_t n,size_t q)
methods.description: Divides n by q and rounds up to the nearest integer.

methods.name: size_t round_up(size_t n,size_t q)
methods.description: Rounds n up to the nearest multiple of q.
